reason: The CIFs are valid ordered primitive P1 models (20 atoms, Z=1, unit occupancies, exact Na3HoTi2Nb2O12 composition), have no overlaps, and their lattice covers every important observed line; however, the submitted atomic coordinates are not sufficiently established by intensities. Over 8-65 degrees, a direct unit-weight whole-pattern calculation for selected.cif gives Rwp about 0.170 (RMS 1.085), versus Rwp about 0.039 (RMS 0.252) for free reflection intensities on the same indexed lattice and approximately 0.14 point noise. The failure is systematic, including observed maxima of 25.6 and 23.1 near 22.63/22.93 degrees versus calculated 11.7 and 10.3. This agrees with the trace's still-high refined RMS (about 1.11): it imported a Cmcm Na3La prototype and refined only seven symmetry-tied coordinate variables, with no independent map/search or unconstrained coordinate recovery. The constrained geometry also leaves nominal Ho3+ strongly underbonded (bond-valence sum about 1.2). The alternative covers a Ti/Nb phase choice but has the same coordinate/intensity failure, so another solution attempt is likely to add a materially different viable atomic realization.
